title: 三座权力的游戏城堡3D建造竞赛
summary: 两个编码代理使用独立的模型和CLI工具，根据统一的参考图和无提示说明，独立构建了三座权力的游戏中的3D城堡。城堡分别是黑城堡、临冬城和临河镇，要求在真实浏览器中运行零错误零警告，并且通过像素和RGB测量验证渲染效果。构建过程中跟踪代码生成、模型调用次数和渲染多边形数量，比较了两个模型（grok 4.6和gpt 5.6 sol）的性能和效率。
summary_en: Two coding agents using separate models and CLIs independently built three 3D castles from Game of Thrones based on identical briefs and reference images with no hints. The castles: Castle Black, Winterfell, and Riverrun must run in a real browser with zero errors or warnings and rendered validated by pixel and RGB measurements. The process tracked code output, model calls, polygon counts to compare the performance and efficiency of grok 4.6 and gpt 5.6 sol models.
workflow_steps_en: Open all four reference photos for each castle before coding.
Generate code for the castle adhering strictly to the reference photos.
Load the generated HTML file in a real browser.
Use a verifier to check for errors, warnings, and shader compile failures.
Measure frame and color exposure with RGB numbers to validate rendering.
Fix any discrepancies exposed by validation before finalizing.
Repeat steps iteratively until zero errors and verified output.
Record metrics: cost, time, tokens, calls, output lines and polygon counts for comparison.
workflow_steps: 针对每座城堡，先完整打开四张参考照片，再写代码。
根据参考图严格生成城堡的HTML文件。
在真实浏览器中加载文件。
使用验证器捕获所有错误、警告及着色器编译失败。
通过RGB数值测量帧，验证渲染曝光度。
根据验证结果修正，直至无误差且验证通过。
反复迭代直到完成。
记录成本、时间、调用次数、代码行数和多边形数量进行性能对比。
evidence_quotes: the setup: each model in its own vendor cli – @spacexai's grok build, @openai's codex – both pointed at one @openrouter key. identical brief, identical reference image, identical verifier. no hints

the binding rule: a verifier that opens the page in a real browser, collects every error and warning including shader compile failures, and measures the frame. zero errors, zero warnings, exposure proven by rgb numbers, every mode checked on its own. shipping unverified is a fail
all six builds passed with zero errors and zero warnings

title: Shima Enaga 3D
summary: 一个完全零资源的交互式3D鸟类宏观观察体验，封装在单一HTML文件中。世界内含超过15867根实例化的3D曲线多瓣羽毛，每根羽毛由多达111069个细小羽支组成，层叠于16层天鹅绒般的绒毛底层，呈现无缝圆润轮廓。环境包括金色阳光照射下有晶莹的雪覆盖的庭院、折射的玻璃温室、樱花盛开、体积光和飘雪效果。支持无碰撞穿越开启的天窗飞行，有缓慢多角度宏观镜头轨道、锐利的景深散景效果。音效由Web Audio API实时合成，包括鸟鸣、翅膀拍打及温室混响。完全由Three.js、自定义GLSL和Web Audio API通过纯数学程序生成，无任何外部模型、贴图或音频文件。
summary_en: A fully zero-asset interactive 3D macro bird-watching experience packed into a single HTML file. It features over 15,867 instanced 3D curved multi-barb feather plumes (111,069 individual barbs) layered over 16 velvety down undercoat shells forming a seamless round silhouette. The environment includes a golden-hour snowy yard, refractive glass greenhouse, blooming sakura, volumetric sunbeams, and exterior falling snow. The bird autonomously flies collision-free through an open skylight with slow multi-angle macro camera orbits and sharp macro depth of field bokeh. Real-time procedural audio synthesis generates bird trills, wing beats, and greenhouse reverb. Everything is procedurally generated by Three.js, custom GLSL shaders, and Web Audio API from pure mathematics with no external 3D models, textures or audio files.
workflow_steps_en: Design procedural algorithm for instanced multi-barb feather plumes and smooth down undercoat
Develop custom GLSL shaders for feather rendering with specular and subsurface effects
Create procedural environment with snowy terrain, refractive glass greenhouse, sakura blossoms, sunbeams, and snow particles
Implement autonomous bird flight state machine with collision-free routing through skylight opening
Set up multi-pass WebGL2 rendering pipeline for refraction, depth textures, bloom, and macro depth of field postprocessing
Synthesize real-time procedural bird chirps, wing beats, ambient soundscape, and convolution reverb with Web Audio API
Integrate camera controls and hidden control panel with various toggles
Package entire experience into a single self-contained HTML file with no external dependencies
workflow_steps: 设计多瓣羽毛实例和绒毛底层的程序算法
编写自定义GLSL羽毛渲染着色器，包含高光和次表面散射
程序生成雪地、折射玻璃温室、樱花、体积光和雪花效果环境
实现鸟类自主飞行状态机和无碰撞天窗穿越路由
搭建多通道WebGL2渲染流水线，支持折射、深度纹理、泛光和宏景深后处理
用Web Audio API实时合成鸟鸣、翅膀声、环境声和混响
集成摄像机控制与隐藏控制面板提供多功能开关
打包为单文件HTML，无任何外部依赖

title: Skyhaven and AURELIA Voxel Worlds via Claude Sonnet 5.5 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
summary: 使用Claude Sonnet 5.5云端模型和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash在两台DGX Sparks节点上，基于相同体素世界提示词各生成一个交互式体素世界。Sonnet模型在云端完成Skyhaven世界，耗时31.9分钟，成本约4.60美元，输出19.4万令牌，并得到了浏览器测试9.0/10分评分。DeepSeek模型在本地两Spark硬件完成AURELIA世界，耗时88.1分钟，无API成本，输出15.9万令牌，浏览器评分8.5/10。两个作品相似但不完全相同，均可在浏览器中交互体验。
summary_en: Using Claude Sonnet 5.5 in the cloud and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on two DGX Sparks, two interactive voxel worlds were generated from the same prompt. Sonnet produced the Skyhaven world in 31.9 minutes for about $4.60 with 194,375 tokens and a browser check rating of 9.0/10. DeepSeek generated the AURELIA world locally on two Sparks in 88.1 minutes with 159,465 tokens and browser rating 8.5/10. The worlds are similar but not identical, both playable in browsers.
workflow_steps_en: Start from a common voxel-world prompt.
Run Claude Sonnet 5.5 in cloud environment to generate Skyhaven world (approx. 31.9 minutes runtime).
Run DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash recipe on two DGX Spark nodes with MiaAI_lab's 2-Spark quantized EXL3 weights to generate AURELIA world (approx. 88.1 minutes runtime).
Collect output tokens and evaluate browser-based interactivity and rendering quality.
Compare both worlds for similarity and presentation quality.
workflow_steps: 以同一体素世界提示词开始生成。
在云端使用Claude Sonnet 5.5生成Skyhaven世界，耗时31.9分钟。
在两台DGX Spark节点本地使用DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash与MiaAI_lab 2-Spark配方和EXL3权重生成AURELIA世界，耗时88.1分钟。
收集生成的令牌输出，评估浏览器中的交互性能和渲染质量。
比较两个世界在效果和表现上的相似度。
evidence_quotes: Claude Sonnet 5.5 in the cloud against DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on two DGX Sparks: same voxel-world prompt, one try each.
Sonnet built Skyhaven in my Claude Code CLI.
The Sparks run @MiaAI_lab's 2-Spark recipe (EXL3 2.9 bpw on TensorFold, commit 370daf0) and built AURELIA.
Sonnet 5.5, cloud: done in 31.9 min
DeepSeek, 2 Sparks: done in 88.1 min
Tokens written, Sonnet: 194,375
Tokens written, DeepSeek: 159,465
Browser check, Sonnet: 9.0/10
Browser check, DeepSeek: 8.5/10
Cost, Sonnet: about $4.60 at API list prices (Anthropic pricing page, Oct 23, 2026), I ran it on my subscription
Cost, 2 Sparks: no API bill, my own hardware

title: 分解可能なロボットのタコのthree.jsアニメーション
summary: この作品は、単一の静止画像をもとに、花びらやレンズ、リンクといったパーツごとにthree.jsコードで分解し再構成したロボットのタコのインタラクティブなシミュレーションである。25秒の動画では、8本の腕に202個のリンクと480個のホイールを持ち、各腕は関節の連なりを計算しポーズを制御する。レンズの回転やマントルの開閉、分解と再組み立てのアニメーションが特徴的である。
summary_en: This work is an interactive simulation of a robot octopus created using three.js code, decomposing a single still image into parts such as petals, lenses, and links, then reconstructing them. The 25-second animation features 8 arms with 202 links and 480 wheels, each arm calculating poses through joint chains. It includes animations like lens rotation, mantle opening, and disassembly followed by reassembly.
workflow_steps_en: Use a single still image as input.
Decompose the image into parts: petals, lenses, links.
Generate three.js code representing each part and their connections.
Render the initial still image in three.js and compare it with the original to correct misalignments in three iterations.
Redesign the octopus to include 8 arms with multiple links and wheels for smoother animation.
Calculate pose each frame by traversing arm joint chains.
Animate features such as lens rotation and detachment, mantle opening with hinges, pump rotation and lifting.
Animate disassembly and quick reassembly during a 330° turntable rotation by 0:16 seconds.
Output a 25-second animation encoded in 2,616 lines of three.js code.
workflow_steps: 用意した静止画をインプットとして利用
花びら、レンズ、リンクなど要素ごとに分解
各パーツと接続をthree.jsコードで生成
three.jsで初期静止画をレンダリングし、オリジナルと比較して3回修正
8本の腕に複数のリンクとホイールを詰め込み再設計
毎フレーム関節連鎖を辿ってポーズ計算
レンズ回転と脱落、マントルのヒンジ開閉、ポンプの回転・せり上がりをアニメーション
0:16秒で330°回転ターンテーブル上の分解と再組立を表現
2,616行のthree.jsコードで25秒の動画出力
skills_or_prompts_used: three.jsによるコード生成とアニメーション制御

title: Waymo遥控驾驶（San Francisco地图）
summary: 这是一个基于旧金山地图的Waymo无人车遥控驾驶模拟器，结合Fable 5.5和three.js技术栈构建。玩家可以手动或使用不同自动驾驶等级操作车辆，执行载客等任务，体验真实街道环境和天气，世界支持多人同步。地图数据来源OpenStreetMap且遵循ODbL协议，整合了USGS的3D地形数据和由ElevenLabs生成的环境音效。内置多种驾驶辅助、天气、时间变化和视觉效果，支持游戏手柄操作。
summary_en: This is a Waymo remote driving simulator based on the San Francisco map, built with Fable 5.5 and three.js tech stack. Players can manually or autonomously operate vehicles at different driving levels to pick up passengers and experience realistic street environments and weather in a multiplayer synchronized world. The map data comes from OpenStreetMap under ODbL, integrating USGS 3D terrain data and ElevenLabs-generated ambience sounds. Built-in features include various driving assists, weather and time variations, visual effects, and gamepad support.
workflow_steps_en: Load San Francisco map data from OpenStreetMap and USGS 3D elevation sources.
Implement rendering and vehicle simulation using three.js and Fable 5.5.
Integrate AI driving assistance levels from manual (no assist) to full self-driving (Level 5).
Create multiplayer synchronization for traffic, time of day and weather conditions.
Develop UI and controls for manual driving, autopilot modes, and gamepad input.
Incorporate ambience, sound and music generation using ElevenLabs AI.
Package the app as an interactive web experience with live demo available.

title: Reimagined Coiffure Mile End Salon
summary: 该实验基于对现实中Coiffure Mile End理发店的三维高斯点云捕获，使用World Labs的Atlas世界模型与作者构建的Ailleurs工具，将该空间转化为色彩丰富的绘画风格版本。两版本空间对齐，通过主镜子实现现实与重构世界的门户转换，展示了空间结构保留下的再创作可能性。
summary_en: This experiment is based on a 3D Gaussian Splat capture of the Coiffure Mile End hair salon, using the Atlas world model from World Labs and the author's Ailleurs tool to create a colorful, painterly version of the same space. The two versions are spatially aligned, enabling the salon's main mirror to act as a portal between the real and reimagined worlds, demonstrating creative possibilities while preserving spatial structure.
workflow_steps_en: Perform 3D Gaussian Splat capture of the Coiffure Mile End salon.
Use World Labs Atlas world model as a foundation.
Utilize the Ailleurs tool built on the World Labs API to transform the captured space into a colorful, painterly version.
Align the transformed version spatially with the original capture.
Create an interactive portal on the salon's main mirror to link the real and reimagined worlds.
workflow_steps: 对Coiffure Mile End理发店进行3D高斯点云捕获。
基于World Labs的Atlas世界模型。
使用构建在World Labs API上的Ailleurs工具，将捕获空间转换为色彩丰富的绘画风格版本。
实现两版本空间对齐。
通过理发店主镜子创建现实与重构世界的门户。
evidence_quotes: One thing I've always been drawn to is transforming those captured spaces into something else.
With world models like Atlas from @theworldlabs , I feel we're reaching a pretty significant milestone.

Starting from a 3DGS capture of Coiffure Mile End, a small hair salon in my neighbourhood, I used Ailleurs, the tool I've been building on top of the World Labs API, to create a colourful, painterly version of the same space.
The two versions are spatially aligned, allowing me to turn the salon's main mirror into a portal between the real and reimagined worlds.

summary_en: An 18-year-old developer used the Claude model with a $20 subscription and 10 minutes to generate a playable GTA-style browser game prototype featuring a small city, cars, police chases, camera controls, weapons, radar, UI, and basic missions. This work demonstrates how AI can quickly replace traditional multi-person weeks-long development, helping brands create engaging mini-games for marketing campaigns.

Input the description into Claude Fable 5 to generate a playable browser prototype.
Playtest the prototype and perform further polishing such as enhancing the map, adding scoreboard, modifying branding.
Package the final product for client use.

title: Zipline Platform 2
summary: Zipline Platform 2 是一个基于专利图纸和工程说明构建的3D航空器交互模型，包含完整的飞机、悬挂的配送机器人及其连接机械装置。用户可以通过WebGL支持的浏览器观察飞机组装、剖面和爆炸视图，并可切换不同视角和剖切平面。配套展现了多个专利栋图，如飞机视图、载体及存放机器人、配送机器人视角以及绞车和系缆接收装置。
summary_en: Zipline Platform 2 is an interactive 3D aircraft model built from patent drawings and engineering notes, featuring the complete aircraft, suspended delivery droid, and connecting machinery. Users can view assembly, cutaway, and exploded views with different perspectives and section planes in a WebGL-enabled browser. It includes patent figures showing aircraft perspective, carrier and stowed droid, delivery droid perspective, and winch tether receiver.
workflow_steps_en: Collect patent drawings and engineering notes related to the Zipline aircraft system.
Build 3D models of the aircraft, delivery droid, and associated mechanical assemblies.
Assemble models to create complete aircraft and subsystem views.
Implement interactive 3D visualization with orbit, zoom, view angle, and section plane controls using WebGL.
Integrate original patent drawings for reference alongside the 3D model.
Publish the interactive 3D world accessible via a WebGL-supported browser.
workflow_steps: 收集Zipline航空系统的专利图纸和工程说明。
构建飞机、配送机器人及关联机械部件的3D模型。
组装模型，完成飞机和子系统视图。
使用WebGL实现包含轨道、缩放、视角和剖切平面的交互3D可视化。
将原始专利图纸整合并展现在3D模型旁作为参考。
发布可通过支持WebGL的浏览器访问的交互3D世界。

title: Every Joule: a 3D physics book about energy
summary: 这是一个交互式3D物理教材，涵盖GCSE和IGCSE物理中的能量主题。内容包括能量储存、动能和重力能、弹性能量、反弹球停止原因、比热容与绝热、功率、效率、电站与电网、食物中的能量以及能量守恒。每个图示都从页面中浮起，展示发光的能量流动，学生可以预测、测试和验证概念，翻页查看答案并获得印章。提供教师笔记和所有资源。
summary_en: This is an interactive 3D physics textbook covering GCSE and IGCSE energy topics: energy stores, kinetic and gravitational energy, elastic energy, why a bouncing ball stops, specific heat capacity and insulation, power, efficiency, power stations and the grid, energy in food, and conservation of energy. Each diagram lifts off the page showing glowing energy flows. Students predict, test, and prove concepts, lift flaps for answers, and earn stamps. Teacher notes and all sources are included.
workflow_steps_en: Create 3D diagrams for each physics energy concept.
Integrate diagrams to lift off a virtual textbook page via WebGL in browser.
Allow interactive tapping on objects like bike or balloon to show energy flow.
Enable student actions: predict outcomes, test, prove results, and reveal answers.
Provide teacher notes and source materials.
Deploy online with hardware accelerated WebGL support.
Use claude opus 5.5 and three.js as core technology stack.
workflow_steps: 为每个物理能量概念创建3D图示。
通过浏览器中的WebGL使图示从虚拟教材页中浮起。
允许点击自行车或气球等对象展示能量流动。
支持学生进行预测、测试、验证并揭示答案。
提供教师笔记和资源。
上线部署，需硬件加速的WebGL支持。
使用claude opus 5.5和three.js作为技术栈。
evidence_quotes: An interactive physics book in ten lessons, covering the energy topic of GCSE and IGCSE physics: energy stores, kinetic and gravitational energy, elastic energy, why a bouncing ball stops, specific heat capacity and insulation, power, efficiency, power stations and the grid, the energy in food, and the conservation of energy. Each diagram lifts off the page as a 3D ink drawing and energy flows as glowing colour between the stores. Students predict, test and prove each idea, lift the flap for the answer and earn a stamp. Teachers’ notes and every source are included.

title: Net Forge Multiplayer Browser Game Engine
summary: Net Forge是一个多人体浏览器游戏引擎，支持快速创建游戏。它提供单一共享仿真用于客户端和服务器，支持类型安全的游戏文件代理编辑，内建自检玩法测试机器人，包含10个现成模板及530个CC0资产。该引擎是专为AI代理设计的开放源码UGC平台，未来将支持内置代币、游戏商店和奖励机制。
summary_en: Net Forge is a multiplayer browser game engine enabling rapid game creation. It features a single shared simulation for client and server, typed game file agents, self-testing playtest bots, 10 ready templates, and 530 CC0 assets. Designed as an open-source UGC platform for AI agents, with plans to integrate tokenized in-game stores and rewards.
workflow_steps_en: Initialize a multiplayer browser game project using Net Forge.
Leverage a single shared simulation environment for both client and server.
Edit game files safely using typed game file agents.
Use built-in playtest bots that test the game automatically.
Choose from 10 ready-made templates (survivors, arena, tower defense, dungeon, kart, cards, etc.).
Utilize 530 CC0 assets included in the engine.
Run the game on MCP server to allow AI agents like Claude or Cursor to interact directly.
Publish the game as open-source on npm.

利用引擎包含的530个CC0资产。
在MCP服务器上运行游戏，允许Claude或Cursor等AI代理直接交互。
将游戏作为开源项目发布在npm上。

title: The Little Prince: Across the Stars
summary: 这个项目是一个基于人工智能创建的3D故事游戏，灵感来自《小王子》。开发者用了16天时间，利用Opus 5.5贯穿整个，从概念到实现，配合Tripo AI和Blender制作3D模型和场景，最后用Unity整合成可在浏览器中玩的游戏。游戏支持英、汉、日三语，需用支持WebGPU的Chrome或Edge浏览器。世界由漂浮在云上的小行星、孤独的椅子、红玫瑰以及故事中的标志性场景组成，玩家可以探索和穿梭其中。该项目展示了AI结合3D工具和游戏引擎带来的创作新可能，体现了单人开发者通过想象力创造互动体验的潜力。
summary_en: This project is an AI-powered 3D story game inspired by The Little Prince. The developer spent 16 days using Opus 5.5 throughout for concept to implementation, Tripo AI and Blender for 3D models and scenes, and Unity to integrate everything into a browser-based playable game. It supports English, Chinese, and Japanese, requiring WebGPU-enabled Chrome or Edge browsers. The world features tiny planets floating above clouds, a lonely chair, a red rose, and iconic story scenes for player exploration. This illustrates how AI combined with 3D tools and game engines enables solo creators to build ambitious interactive experiences from imagination.
workflow_steps_en: Use Opus 5.5 from initial concept to implementation for development.
Create 3D models and scenes using Tripo AI and Blender.
Integrate the experience into a playable browser game with Unity.

title: Solo Dev 3D Game Combining Ragnarok Online with Monster Hunter
summary: 一个零代码和游戏开发经验的单人开发者，使用Opus 5.5和Godot在6周内构建了一个可玩的3D游戏。游戏结合了Ragnarok Online与Monster Hunter元素，包含自定义角色、环境、3D资产、视觉效果和着色器。主要开发依靠Opus 5.5通过Claude Code，Codex生成视觉参考和资源，Tripo AI将参考转为3D模型，Blender用于小型物品。开发者还搭建了自定义AI工作流程以保持统一艺术风格、分配编码任务、维持上下文和校验研究。预算约每月400美元，游戏仍在开发中。
summary_en: A solo developer with zero coding or game development experience built a playable 3D game in 6 weeks using Opus 5.5 and Godot. The game combines Ragnarok Online and Monster Hunter, featuring custom characters, environments, 3D assets, VFX, and shaders. Most development is handled by Opus 5.5 through Claude Code, Codex generates visual references and assets, Tripo AI converts references to 3D models, and Blender is used for smaller objects. The developer created custom AI workflows to maintain consistent art style, delegate coding tasks, preserve session context, and verify research. Budget is about $400/month; development is ongoing.
workflow_steps_en: Use Opus 5.5 through Claude Code to handle most of the game development tasks.
Generate visual references and assets with Codex.
Convert visual references into 3D models using Tripo AI.
Use Blender to create smaller objects.
Build custom AI workflows for consistent art style, coding task delegation, session context preservation, and research verification.

title: 超写实国家旅游微缩场景海报
summary: 本作品为一幅超写实3D微缩场景旅游海报，画面呈现漂浮的微型岛屿，集合某国的标志性地标、历史建筑、自然奇观、文化元素及本土野生动物。沿着用国旗色彩绘制的丝带路径，将各个景点有机连接。采用电影般的黄金时刻光效和体积大气，整体质感媲美博物馆级工艺，适合作为高端旅游宣传画。
summary_en: This work is an ultra-realistic 3D miniature travel poster featuring a floating island that showcases a country's iconic landmarks, historic architecture, natural wonders, cultural elements, and native wildlife. A ribbon pathway painted in the national flag colors connects all landmarks. Cinematic golden-hour lighting and volumetric atmosphere provide a museum-quality craftsmanship aesthetic, suitable for premium tourism campaign posters.
workflow_steps_en: Design prompt describing an ultra-detailed 3D miniature diorama travel poster.
Use Octane render and Unreal Engine 5 to create a hyper-realistic floating island scene.
Incorporate the country name in expressive typography with a national flag and elegant tagline.
Include iconic landmarks, architecture, natural wonders, cultural motifs, traditional clothing, monuments, coastline, mountains, temples, castles, markets, boats, and wildlife.
Add a flowing ribbon path in flag colors connecting all landmarks visually.
Apply cinematic golden-hour lighting, volumetric atmosphere, intricate textures, and tilt-shift macro photography effects.
Render in photorealistic 8K resolution with centered composition and vibrant natural colors.
Prepare the image with clean negative space and luxurious print design for high-end editorial tourism posters.

summary: 这是一个使用three.js实现的自运行3D等距俯视地下城探险游戏。游戏画面采用暗黑且质感细腻的风格，主角手持火炬和剑，在石质地下城中逐个房间探索。光影效果真实，火炬光照发出温暖光线并投射动态阴影，墙壁火把和熔炉也发出暖光，魔法符文和月光提供冷光对比。地面有裂纹、青苔和反光水洼，环境中有箱子、骨骼、陷阱等道具。怪物包括骷髅、巨鼠和史莱姆，三层一只更强大Boss，能感知主角并主动攻击。主角自动行走、探索、战斗、开箱，受伤时喝药水，自动下层，玩家可随时用键盘或手柄接管操控。HUD显示生命、金币、深度、击杀数。音效由Web Audio合成，起始无音频需点击角落提示启用。整个游戏单文件HTML，窗口大小自适应，60fps流畅运行，无控制台错误。
summary_en: This is a self-playing 3D isometric dungeon exploration game built with three.js. The lone adventurer carrying a torch and a sword explores stone dungeons room by room. The style is dark and gritty with realistic lighting and moving shadows from the torch and other light sources. Floors have cracks, moss, and reflective puddles. The dungeon contains barrels, crates, bones, traps, and monsters such as skeletons, giant rats, and slimes, with a stronger boss every third level. Monsters detect and attack the player who fights back automatically, opens chests, drinks potions, and descends levels continuously. Players can take control at any time via keyboard or gamepad. A pixel font HUD shows health, gold, depth, and kills. Sounds are synthesized with Web Audio, initially off until a corner click enables them. The game runs as a single self-contained HTML file, resizes cleanly, runs smoothly at 60fps without console errors.
workflow_steps_en: Define game concept and visual style inspired by dark, gritty, and warmly lit dungeon scenes.
Implement an isometric 3D camera using three.js with smooth follow of the player character.
Procedurally build dungeon rooms and corridors with stone walls, floors with cracks, moss, puddles reflecting light, doors, cells, pillars, stairs, barrels, crates, bones, traps, and decorations.
Create a player character model with walk cycles, sword swings, hit reactions, and torch that emits flickering point light casting dynamic shadows.
Program monsters (skeletons, giant rats, slimes, bosses) with AI to roam rooms, detect the player, approach and attack.
Implement autonomous player AI to explore, fight monsters, open chests, drink potions, find keys, unlock doors, and descend levels repeatedly.
Add pixel-style postprocessing with reduced resolution and ordered Bayer dither to achieve a subtle textured look.
Apply tilt-shift postprocessing with depth-aware lens blur to simulate a miniature diorama effect, including vignette and film grain.
Develop a pixel font HUD displaying health hearts, gold, depth, and monsters slain.
Integrate Web Audio synthesized sound effects for footsteps, torch crackling, sword swings and hits, monster sounds, coins, door unlocks, and dungeon ambient drone.
Add UI hint for enabling audio by user click as browsers require gesture to start audio.
Ensure full-window resizing support, smooth 60 fps performance, and zero console errors on load.
workflow_steps: 定义暗黑质感且温暖灯光风格的游戏概念。
用three.js实现等距3D相机，平滑跟随主角。
程序化生成带有裂纹、青苔、水洼反光的石质地下城房间及走廊，包含门、铁栏牢房、柱子、楼梯、桶、箱子、骨骼、陷阱等。
创建带有行走、挥剑、受击动作及摇摆火炬光的主角模型，火炬点光源产生动态阴影。
设计骷髅、巨鼠、史莱姆及Boss怪AI，在房间游荡、发现并攻击主角。
实现自主AI自动探索、战斗、开箱、喝药水、找钥匙开门并下层。
用降分辨率和有序Bayer抖动后期处理，实现细腻纹理像素画风。
后期添加景深倾斜移轴模糊和暗角、胶片颗粒，表现微缩模型效果。
开发显示生命、金币、深度、杀戮数的像素字体HUD。
集成Web Audio合成音效，包括脚步声、火炬爆裂声、剑击声、怪物叫声、金币声、开门声和环境低音。
添加角落点击启用音频的提示。
支持窗口自适应，保持60fps流畅，无控制台错误。
evidence_quotes: Create one complete, self-contained HTML file for TORCHLIGHT DEPTHS, a self-playing 3D isometric dungeon explorer game in three.js that needs no user input (the player can take over at any time): a lone adventurer carrying a burning torch in one hand and a sword in the other explores a gritty stone dungeon, room by room, by torchlight.

Use a dark, gritty, lovingly lit aesthetic. The camera is a true isometric-style view (orthographic or a long-lens perspective at a classic three-quarter angle from above) that follows the player smoothly.

LIGHT IS THE STAR: the player's torch is a flickering warm point light that casts real moving shadows of pillars, crates, bars and monsters across the floor and walls; wall torches and braziers in sconces throw their own warm pools of light; a few cold accents (a blue glow from a magic rune, moonlight through a grate) contrast with the warm fire; embers and sparks drift up from every flame; dust hangs in the torch beams.

Build the dungeon in code: rough stone-block walls with cut-away fronts so the isometric camera can always see the player, flagstone floors with cracks, moss and puddles that reflect the firelight, wooden doors, iron-barred cells, pillars, stairs down, rubble, barrels, crates, bones, cobwebs, chests, banners and a few traps (spike plates, a swinging blade); rooms linked by corridors, with a sense of going deeper.
Monsters roam: skeletons, giant rats and a slime or two, each readable by torchlight with a small glow in their eyes.

The PLAYER is a small, clearly built adventurer (hooded cloak, armour, a torch held high casting the main light, a sword) with a proper walk cycle, a sword swing with a clear arc and impact, a hit flinch, and a torch that sways with each step.

SELF-PLAYING, WITH OPTIONAL CONTROLS: the hero plays itself from the moment the page loads and never needs a key, click or touch, but the player can take over at any time with WASD or the arrow keys to move and Space to attack (a gamepad works too); after a few seconds without input, the hero goes back to playing itself, and it never gets stuck on walls, doors or props.

ENEMIES MUST BE PRESENT AND ACTIVE: every room and most corridors hold monsters that are clearly visible on screen (skeletons, giant rats, slimes, and a bigger boss monster on every third level), they notice the hero, approach and attack, and the hero fights them in frequent, readable sword fights with swings, hits, knockback, hit flashes and monsters collapsing or bursting into bones and goo; a fight should be on screen most of the time, never long stretches of an empty dungeon.
A small HUD shows health hearts, gold, depth and monsters slain, in a crisp pixel font.

Add synthesized sound with Web Audio: footsteps on stone, the crackling torch, sword swings and hits, monster squeals, coins, a door unlocking and a low dungeon drone; because browsers gate audio behind a gesture, show only a small, unobtrusive "click for sound" hint in a corner that enables audio when clicked; the game itself starts and runs immediately without it and never waits for any input.
Make it fill the window, resize cleanly, run smoothly at 60 fps and start with zero console errors.
Deliver it as a single self-contained HTML file; any libraries are allowed.

summary: 「G-WARS」はゲームマーケット2026秋の新作ブラウザゲームで、スマホやPCで1人または2人で遊べる。11月末まで期間限定公開。3Dプリント受注生産も同期間延長。ルールはタイルを操作して自分の色のタマゴを縦横につなげて10個にすることが勝利条件。1ターンに最大2回のアクション（移動、ヘッド・オン、コンバット、スライド、パンチ）と1回のタイル配置がある。盤面は5×5マスでタイルは辺で接続。操作はドラッグで回転、ピンチ/ホイールで拡大縮小、タップで決定。BGMや効果音設定あり。
summary_en: G-WARS is a new game from Game Market 2026 Autumn, available as a browser game playable on smartphone or PC by one or two players, limited until the end of November. The victory condition is connecting 10 of your colored eggs (and yellow) vertically or horizontally on a 5x5 board. Each turn allows up to two Action A moves (move, head-on, combat tile, slide, punch) and one Action B tile placement adjacent to your tiles. Tiles must connect by edges. Controls include drag to rotate board, pinch/wheel to zoom, tap to confirm. Background music and sound effects are available.

Game ends when player connects 10 eggs or tiles run out or a player cannot place tile
Control board by drag (rotation), pinch/wheel (zoom), tap to select
Adjust sound settings (BGM, SFX, mute)
Restart or return to title screen

title: ASRock Intel® Arc™ Pro B70 Creator 32GB - AI Workstation GPU
summary: ASRockのIntel Arc Pro B70 Creator 32GBは32GB GDDR6搭載の業務用GPUで、AI推論や3Dレンダリングなどワークステーション向けに設計。Xe2アーキテクチャ、256bit幅メモリ、367TOPSのINT8性能を持ち、最大4枚搭載で128GB VRAM運用可能。vLLMでOpenAIのgpt-oss-20bをローカル高速推論でき、分散動作で速度向上。特殊な冷却設計により複数枚搭載時の熱問題を克服。SR-IOV機能もあり1枚を最大7仮想GPUに分割し複数仮想デスクトップも同時運用可能。Linux対応でoneAPIやOpenVINOも利用可能。VRAM不足問題を解決しつつ高負荷連続稼働に対応するAI開発向けGPU。
summary_en: The ASRock Intel Arc Pro B70 Creator 32GB is a professional GPU equipped with 32GB GDDR6, designed for AI inference and 3D rendering workstations. Built on Xe2 architecture with 256-bit memory and 367 INT8 TOPS performance, it supports up to 4 GPUs for 128GB total VRAM. It enables fast local LLM inference (e.g. gpt-oss-20b with vLLM) with speedup by multi-GPU distribution. It features blower-style cooling to prevent overheating when multiple cards are installed. SR-IOV allows partitioning one GPU into 7 virtual GPUs for running multiple virtual desktops. Compatible with Linux, oneAPI, and OpenVINO, it targets high VRAM requirements and stable long-duration AI workloads.
workflow_steps_en: Select Intel Arc Pro B70 Creator 32GB GPU for workstation use
Install ASRock B70 Creator GPUs with blower-style cooling for multi-GPU configuration
Set up Linux environment with oneAPI, OpenVINO, or Intel PyTorch extension
Deploy local large language model (e.g. OpenAI gpt-oss-20b) with vLLM
Run inference on single GPU or distribute model across multiple GPUs for higher throughput
Utilize GPU SR-IOV virtualization to partition GPUs for multiple virtual desktops
workflow_steps: ASRockのIntel Arc Pro B70 Creator 32GBでワークステーション向けGPUを選定
複数枚搭載を考慮したブロワーファン冷却でGPU設置

skills_or_prompts_used: Intel Xe2アーキテクチャ理解

evidence_quotes: OpenAIのオープンウェイトモデルgpt-oss-20bをvLLMで動作させたところ、B70を1枚使用した構成で約116トークン/秒、2枚に分散させると約179トークン/秒という結果が出ています。
4枚搭載してテストしているんですよｗｗｗ 32GBを4枚なので合計128GB、対応した推論ソフトウェアでモデルを分散させることで、1枚には収まらないgpt-oss-120bまで動作させています。
ソフトウェアはIntel oneAPIやOpenVINO、Intel Extension for PyTorchなどに対応していて、Linux環境でローカルLLMを動かすこともできます。

title: Fantasy City 3D Scene Generation with Claude and Blender MCP
summary: 这是一个利用Claude语言模型和Blender MCP插件，将灰色Blender场景转变为具有800年历史感的幻想城市的AI生成交互式世界。用户描述世界细节，如哥特式塔楼、巨大发光树和氛围，Claude在Blender中构建初始场景，然后进行多轮渲染、检查、调整灯光和材质，不断完善场景，从而使其如电影画面般逼真。
summary_en: This is an AI-generated interactive world that uses the Claude language model and Blender MCP plugin to transform a grey Blender scene into a fantasy city with 800 years of lore. The user describes details like gothic towers, a giant glowing tree, and atmosphere; Claude builds the initial scene in Blender and iteratively renders, inspects, adjusts lighting and materials, progressively refining the scene until it looks like a cinematic frame.
workflow_steps_en: User describes the fantasy world scene to Claude with details (e.g., gothic towers, glowing tree, fog)
Claude builds the initial 3D scene inside Blender using the MCP plugin
Render the scene in Blender and inspect the result
Notice imperfections or lifeless elements in the scene
Adjust lighting, materials, atmosphere, and composition based on inspection
Render again and repeat the inspection and adjustment loop until the scene feels like a real place
workflow_steps: 用户向Claude描述幻想世界场景的细节（如哥特式塔楼、发光的树、雾气）
Claude利用Blender MCP插件在Blender中构建初始3D场景
在Blender中渲染场景并检查结果
发现场景中显得死板或不够生动的部分
根据检查结果调整灯光、材质、大气和构图
再次渲染并重复检查和调整循环，直至场景如真实地方般生动
evidence_quotes: Claude + Blender MCP is the reason this gets interesting. You describe the world - gothic towers, a giant glowing tree, fog, cold stone, a lone figure with a banner and Claude can build the first scene inside Blender instead of leaving you alone with the default viewport and a mild panic attack.
Then it does the useful part: render, inspect, notice what looks dead, adjust the lighting, materials, atmosphere and composition, and run it again.

title: Ori-style Platformer with AI-generated Assets and Code
summary: 构建了一个类似《奥日》的平台游戏，使用GPT Image 2.5生成风格板，Tripo和Blender制作低多边形3D模型，Opus 5.5编写游戏代码，ElevenLabs创作音效和音乐。游戏场景包含风暴、沉船、码头、浮标和一个发光的巨大Boss，主角为2D跑跳攻击精灵嵌入3D世界。Boss的光线显示其攻击的位置。整体设计遵循“先让它存在，再让它更好”的原则。
summary_en: Built an Ori-style platformer using GPT Image 2.5 for mood boards, Tripo and Blender for low-poly 3D models, Opus 5.5 for game code, and ElevenLabs for sound and music. Features a stormy scene with wrecked ships, piers, buoys, and a glowing giant boss. The hero is a 2D sprite within a 3D world. The boss's light shows where its fist will land. The principle was to make it exist before making it good.
workflow_steps_en: Create mood boards with GPT Image 2.5 depicting storm, piers, wrecks, and a glowing boss.
Use Tripo P2 to convert mockups into 3D models: giant, ships, piers, buoys.
Clean up in Blender: adjust scale, pivots, optimize low poly for 60 fps on phones.
Keep the hero as a 2D sprite with run, jump, attack animations embedded in 3D world.
Write game logic with Opus 5.5: movement, jumps, camera, rain, water effects.
Implement boss mechanic: giant's light indicates fist landing spot.
Add sound effects and music using ElevenLabs.
Deploy game to Vercel and share the link.
workflow_steps: 用GPT Image 2.5做风格板：风暴、码头、残骸、一个发光的Boss。
用Tripo P2将设计图转成3D模型：巨人、船、码头、浮标。
Blender中清理模型：调整比例、旋转点，制作低多边形以保证手机60帧。
主角保持2D：一个跑、跳、攻击的精灵放入3D世界。
用Opus 5.5编写游戏：运动、跳跃、摄像机、雨水、水效果。
Boss有可读规则：巨人的灯光显示拳头落点位置。
用ElevenLabs做音效和音乐。
部署到Vercel，发送链接，观看玩家挑战巨人。
evidence_quotes: I built an Ori-style platformer with GPT Image 2.5, Tripo and Claude Opus 5.5, and it runs on desktop and on a phone.
Step 1 -> Mood boards in GPT Image 2.5: storm, piers, wrecks, one boss that glows.
Step 2 -> Tripo P2 turns the mockups into 3D: the giant, the ships, the piers, the buoys.
Step 3 -> Blender cleanup: scale, pivots, low poly so a phone can hold 60 fps.
Step 4 -> The hero stays 2D: a run, jump, attack sprite dropped into the 3D world.
Step 5 -> Opus 5.5 writes the game: movement, jumps, camera, rain, water.
Step 7 -> SFX and music from ElevenLabs, at the very end.
Step 8 -> Deploy to Vercel, send the link, watch people die to the giant.

title: WizardGenie AI Game Engine

WizardGenie is in Beta, enabling physics-driven 3D AI generation, text and video to animation, suitable for all types of game creation.

title: 雾锁山门 (Mist-Locked Gate)
summary: 《雾锁山门》是由歸藏利用 guizang-game-skill 用 AI 生成素材并结合 three.js 开发的一款可在浏览器中运行的 3D 动作游戏。游戏画面采用 three.js 自建渲染流程，兼容手机和小程序容器。游戏含有五个骨骼绑定的3D角色、两件武器、十二种场景道具和五种掉落物。战斗系统具备三段连招、闪避、格挡、弹反、处决、饮药、御剑和大招“万剑归宗”，且Boss设有二阶段、起身过场和台词。游戏配有8条配音、配乐、环境音效，整体素材将近100MB，最终打包为单一约33MB的HTML文件。开发流程包含调研与规划、设定与素材、动作、手感与特效、声音与打包。
summary_en: Mist-Locked Gate is a 3D action game created by Guizang using the guizang-game-skill combining AI-generated assets and three.js to run in browsers. The game features a custom three.js rendering pipeline compatible with phones and mini-app containers. It contains 5 rigged 3D characters, 2 weapons, 12 props, and 5 loot types. Combat includes combos, dodge, block, parry, execution, healing, sword riding and ultimate skill "Ten Thousand Swords Return". Bosses have two stages with cutscenes and lines. Sound has 8 voice lines, music, ambient and effects. Original assets total nearly 100MB, packaged into a single ~33MB HTML file. The workflow is research & planning, setting & assets, animation, feel & effects, sound & packing.
workflow_steps_en: Research and plan: read references, plan stages.
Setting and assets: generate AI concept art, convert to 3D models with Tripo.
Animation: create actions like combos, dodge, block, parry, execution.
Feel and effects: adjust controls, add visual effects.
Sound and packing: add voice lines, music, ambient sounds, and package as single HTML.
workflow_steps: 调研与规划：阅读参考，制定分阶段计划。
设定与素材：用 AI 生成设定图，再用 Tripo 转成 3D 模型。
动作：开发战斗动作，含三段连招、闪避、格挡等。
手感与特效：调整操作手感，添加特效。
声音与打包：配音、配乐、环境音效及打包成单文件。

title: Image-Blaster: Single Photo to Fully Playable 3D World
summary: Image-Blaster 是一个开源工具，它能将一张照片在五分钟内转化为完整的三维可交互世界，包括3D物体模型、静态环境、光照和环境声音，由Claude协调完成。用户将照片放入输入文件夹，Claude识别场景中的物体，生成干净的参考图像，然后调用3D生成模型生成每个物体的网格和材质，再通过World Labs构建可探索环境。支持真实照片和AI生成图像，输出不锁定，用户可以导入Unity、Unreal、Godot、Blender或Three.js继续编辑。
summary_en: Image-Blaster is an open-source tool that converts a single photo into a fully playable 3D interactive world within five minutes, including 3D object meshes, static environment, lighting, and ambient sound, orchestrated by Claude. The user drops a photo into an input folder, Claude detects objects, generates clean reference images for each, calls a 3D generation model for meshes and materials, then uses World Labs to build the explorable environment. Both real photos and AI-generated images work. Output files can be imported into Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, or Three.js for further editing.
workflow_steps_en: Install Claude Code from Anthropic if not installed.
Clone the repository from /neilsonnn/image-blaster and enter the folder.
Run Claude via terminal and provide API keys for World Labs, FAL, and optionally ElevenLabs for sound.
Drop a photo into the input/ folder.
Command Claude to process the image and confirm each step interactively.
Claude extracts objects and generates clean reference images.
Send references to 3D generation models to create object meshes and materials.
Use World Labs to build a static explorable environment with lighting and ambient sound.
Obtain output files that can be imported into various 3D tools like Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, or Three.js for further refinement.
workflow_steps: 确保已安装Claude Code。
克隆 /neilsonnn/image-blaster 仓库并进入文件夹。
通过终端启动Claude，提供World Labs和FAL的API密钥，可选ElevenLabs密钥。
将图片放入input/文件夹。
指示Claude执行并逐步确认操作。
Claude提取图像中的物体并生成干净的参考图。
将参考图发送给3D生成模型生成物体网格和材质。
用World Labs构建静态可探索环境，包括光照和环境声音。
输出文件可导入Unity、Unreal、Godot、Blender或Three.js继续编辑。
evidence_quotes: Feed it one image, get back a complete 3D world: 3D object meshes, a static environment, lighting, and ambient sound, all generated and assembled by Claude.
You drop a photo into a folder and Claude looks at the scene, then orchestrates a chain of models to rebuild it in 3D.
It generates a separate 3D mesh (.glb/.obj) for every object you want, builds the static room environment as a Gaussian splat, adds object-specific and ambient sound effects, and bakes in lighting.

Claude is the orchestrator. It picks objects out of your image, generates a clean reference image for each, sends those to a 3D generation model for meshes and materials, then sends the cleaned-up room to World Labs to build the explorable environment.
The output isn't locked in. It's just files on your computer, so you can drag the whole thing into Unity, Unreal, Godot, Blender, or a Three.js app and keep building.

summary_en: Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5 independently generated a real-time 3D naval battle environment in the browser, featuring physics, dynamic ocean simulation with PBR ocean shaders, wind-driven sails, cannonball trajectory physics, dynamic lighting, particle splash effects, and interactive camera controls. workflow_steps_en: Input a single-line prompt: 'Create a single HTML file featuring two fully rigged sailing ships fighting on a dynamic ocean with particle effects and interactive camera controls'.
Model independently generates full 3D game environment including physics, lighting, ocean shaders, and interactions without additional instructions.

workflow_steps: 输入单行提示：“Create a single HTML file featuring two fully rigged sailing ships fighting on a dynamic ocean with particle effects and interactive camera controls”。

evidence_quotes: Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Claude Opus 5.5 were asked to code a real-time naval battle in a browser, and both models independently built fully functional 3D game environments with physics, lighting, and dynamic ocean simulation.
The entire prompt was one line: "Create a single HTML file featuring two fully rigged sailing ships fighting on a dynamic ocean with particle effects and interactive camera controls".

PBR ocean shaders, wind-driven sails, cannonball trajectory physics, dynamic lighting, particle splash effects, camera orbit controls -- the exact game loop structure, and not one of those words was in the prompt.
Claude Opus 5.5 went furthest and named its own app GhostFleet Engine, featuring live API cost tracking counters per second, custom weather toggles and a cinematic replay mode.

title: AI Models Generate Tropical Island 3D Environment

summary_en: Four AI models were tasked with transforming a tropical island into a fully realized 3D environment. All created the core setting with turquoise water, green mountains, sandy beaches, and overwater villas. The Fable model produced a detailed and polished scene, while OpenAI models offered cheaper alternatives, with GPT-5.1-mini being the least costly. There is a trade-off between cost and quality, making different models suitable for different projects.
workflow_steps_en: Define the challenge to convert a tropical island into a 3D environment.
Apply four distinct AI models independently to generate the environment.
Collect details on time taken and cost for each model.
Compare visual quality and cost efficiency of the generated environments.

对生成环境的质量和成本进行比较。
evidence_quotes: Claude Fable 5.2 built its version in 1h 31m for $78.45
Claude Opus 5.5 took 1h 56m and cost $54.96
GPT-5.4 cost just $8.18 and finished in 1h 12m

all four models created the same core environment, with turquoise water, green mountains, sandy beaches and overwater villas

title: Baldur’s Gate 3 Web Rebuild by GPT-6 Astra
summary: 使用GPT-6 Astra(high)在48小时内逆向工程并重建了Baldur’s Gate 3的部分世界，采用Babylon.js技术。该原型允许用户在浏览器中互动，包括行走、跳跃、开门、对话选择及技能掷骰。重建特色包括体积雾效、压缩动画曲线、皮肤次表面散射、HDR自动曝光等。还通过LLVM和Unicorn执行原版代码片段，并比对原视频确保准确。基于社区工具MacLarian、libbg3和Knit。当前仍为早期部分原型，性能待优化。
summary_en: Using GPT-6 Astra(high), a partial reverse-engineering and rebuilding of Baldur’s Gate 3 was completed within 48 hours using Babylon.js. The prototype enables browser interaction including walking, jumping, opening doors, dialogue choices, and skill dice rolls. Features rebuilt include volumetric fog, compressed animation curves, subsurface skin diffusion, and HDR auto-exposure. Original game code was JIT-compiled with LLVM and ARM64 routines emulated with Unicorn for accuracy, verified against original game videos. Community tools MacLarian, libbg3, and Knit were utilized. It remains an early partial prototype with performance needing improvement.

Used JIT compilation with LLVM and ARM64 emulation with Unicorn to run selected original game shader code for accuracy
Compared the rebuilt version with original game videos to verify fidelity
Incorporated community tools MacLarian, libbg3, and Knit to aid reconstruction
Produced an interactive browser prototype allowing walking, jumping, door interaction, dialogue choices, and skill dice rolls

title: Atlas 世界模型平台
summary: Atlas世界模型是一款基于高斯泼溅建立的3D生成与编辑工作流平台，提供取景器(Viewfinder)、雕刻(Chisel)、重打光(Relight)、溅射转网格(Splat to Mesh)四大工具，支持通过图片和描述生成3D内容，能够导出模型用于游戏引擎或3D软件，并配有浏览器实时预览工具Frameboy。积分系统允许用户付费生成和精修内容。
summary_en: Atlas is a 3D content generation and editing workflow platform based on Gaussian splats. It provides four main tools: Viewfinder for designing camera trajectories with Gaussian splats, Chisel for generating 3D models from images or descriptions using LLMs like Gemini 4 Argon, Relight for re-lighting scenes, and Splat to Mesh for converting splats to real mesh geometry exportable to game engines or 3D software. The platform includes Frameboy for real-time browser preview and uses a credit system for paid generation and refinement.
workflow_steps_en: Use Viewfinder to generate Gaussian splats from one or more images and design camera trajectories based on them.
Use Chisel to generate 3D models from images or textual descriptions via large language models such as Gemini 4 Argon.
Apply Relight tool to adjust lighting, shadows and atmosphere on generated Gaussian splat scenes.
Convert Gaussian splat scenes to real mesh geometry (GLB format) using Splat to Mesh, enabling export to game engines or 3D software like Blender.
Preview generated worlds in real-time via the Frameboy browser tool.
workflow_steps: 使用取景器(Viewfinder)基于一张或多张图像生成高斯泼溅，设计运镜轨迹，并用生图/生视频模型生成渲染。
使用雕刻(Chisel)根据图片或描述，调用LLM（默认Gemini 4 Argon，也可选GPT和Claude）生成3D建模。
使用重打光(Relight)对高斯泼溅场景进行重新打光、加阴影、调氛围。
使用溅射转网格(Splat to Mesh)将高斯泼溅转成带几何网格(GLB)，导出到游戏引擎和3D软件。
通过浏览器中的Frameboy实时预览生成的世界。
evidence_quotes:
Atlas里有四大工具：
1. Viewfinder 取景器：可以根据一张或多张图像生成高斯泼溅，你可以基于高斯泼溅来设计运镜轨迹，再用生图/生视频模型生成完整的渲染。这样生成的视频一致性相当的高，也没有明显的像素闪烁
2. Chisel 雕刻：可以根据图片或者描述，使用LLM帮你生成3d建模，目前默认是 gemini 4 Argon，也可以选GPT和Claude（构建中的页面后台挂久了容易中断和卡死）
3. Relight 重打光：对已经生成的高斯泼溅场景重新打光、加阴影、调氛围，适合后期快速换光照风格
4. Splat to Mesh 溅射转网格：把高斯泼溅转成带真实几何的网格（GLB），可导出到游戏引擎、Blender 等传统3D工具继续用
积分用完大概 1000分≈1美元，完整精修 splat 大概 5000 分一次，失败一般不扣分

title: 3D Moving Mascot from Product Photo
summary: 该项目利用图像转3D工具（如Meshy或Tripo）将单张产品照片转换为完整的3D模型，实现模型旋转视角。通过自动绑定骨骼，模型可以执行摆动、鞠躬和舞蹈等动作。最终产出一个GLB文件，支持在广告、登录页和浏览器游戏中使用。Claude Code负责加载模型、调整比例和场景布置。这一流程适合小品牌和独立开发者，只需免费套餐和一晚完成。
summary_en: This project uses image-to-3D tools like Meshy or Tripo to convert a single product photo into a full 3D model with rotatable views. Auto-rigging adds a skeleton that enables animations such as waving, bowing, and dancing. The output is a GLB file usable in ads, landing pages, and browser games. Claude Code handles loading, scaling correction, and scene setup. This workflow suits small brands and indie developers, requiring only a free tier and one evening of work.
workflow_steps_en: Take a front-shot photo of the plush toy, figurine, or brand mascot on a plain background.
Use an image-to-3D tool like Meshy or Tripo to create a 3D model from the photo.
Apply auto-rigging to add a skeleton for animations.
Select desired moves from an animation library (e.g., waving, bowing, dancing).
Export the animated character as a GLB file usable across ads, landing pages, and browser games.
Use Claude Code to load the model, fix scale and orientation, and stage the scene for final video or interaction.
workflow_steps: 拍摄一张正面纯色背景的毛绒玩具、手办或品牌吉祥物照片。
使用图片转3D工具如Meshy或Tripo将照片生成3D模型。
自动绑定骨骼，使模型可进行动作变形。
从动画库挑选若干动作，如挥手、鞠躬、跳舞。
导出包含动画的GLB文件，支持广告、登录页及浏览器小游戏中使用。
利用Claude Code加载模型，修正比例及朝向，并布置场景制作视频。
evidence_quotes: an image-to-3D tool like Meshy or Tripo turns that single photo into a full 3D model you can spin around, back and sides included
auto-rigging gives it a skeleton, so the toy that only ever sat on a shelf can now bend, wave and turn its head
you pick a handful of moves from an animation library (Meshy alone lists 600+)
everything comes out as one GLB file, so the same character works in your ad, on your landing page and inside a small browser game
Claude Code wires it together: loads the model, fixes the scale so it doesn't show up giant or lying on its back, and stages the scene for the video

title: GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 Rebuild Happy Wheels
summary: 使用GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5模型，根据同一玩法参考和任务，重建了浏览器可玩的Happy Wheels“瓶子跑”小游戏。GPT-6 Astra版本更接近原作，人物比例、车辆和场景更具原版感觉；Claude Opus 5.5版本风格更卡通，包含经典的“胜利”横幅和搞笑动画。
summary_en: Using GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 models, the playable browser game "Bottle Run" from Happy Wheels was rebuilt based on the same gameplay reference and task. GPT-6 Astra's version looks closer to the original with familiar character proportions, bike, and scene feel; Claude Opus 5.5's version goes for a more cartoonish style, featuring classic "VICTORY" banner and humorous animations.
workflow_steps_en: Provide identical gameplay reference and task to GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 models: rebuild the Bottle Run playable browser game from Happy Wheels.
Run GPT-6 Astra for 41 minutes 35 seconds to generate the game.
Run Claude Opus 5.5 for 1 hour 6 minutes 22 seconds to generate the game.
Compare the resulting games on character proportions, bike, scene feel, and animations.
Evaluate and score the outputs visually.
workflow_steps: 给GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5模型相同的玩法参考与任务，重建Happy Wheels瓶子跑的浏览器游戏。
GPT-6 Astra运行41分35秒生成游戏。
Claude Opus 5.5运行1小时6分22秒生成游戏。
比较两版游戏的人物比例、自行车和场景感觉以及动画效果。
最终对作品进行视觉评分。
evidence_quotes: GPT-6 ASTRA AND CLAUDE OPUS 5.5 JUST REBUILT HAPPY WHEELS.
GPT-6 Astra xHigh • 41:35
Opus 5.5 Extra • 1:06:22
Astra gets my vote for looking closer to the original - the character proportions, bike, and overall scene feel more familiar.
Opus goes more cartoonish. But getting a “VICTORY” banner while the dad lands face-first? That’s peak Happy Wheels.

summary: 我放弃了11年的企业职业生涯，利用AI在24小时内打造了全球首个AAA级科幻第一人称射击游戏。该游戏包含快速的第一人称射击战斗、史诗级枪械、手雷和近战系统，玩家可在宽广的战场上驾驶、飞行并战斗，还包括巨型Boss战斗（如步行者、泰坦和利维坦）。游戏的图形、玩法、概念艺术、音乐、动画、音效、配音和47种语言本地化全部由AI制作，使用Three.js构建。创建过程中融合了Tripo制作的世界级3D角色、车辆和纪念碑模型，以及Opus 5.5和Blender的高级游戏质量渲染。

title: $20 Claude Game Evolving Into a $3,000 Brand Demo
summary: 这是一个由18岁开发者使用Claude工作流构建的浏览器城市模拟游戏，最初仅包含汽车、道路和基础移动功能。随着不断迭代，游戏逐步增加了任务、交通信号灯、更宽的街道、命名商店、汽车旅馆标志、住宅标签及更整洁的城市布局等元素。同时提升了细节，如NPC对话、更精细的纹理、更强的光照、更流畅的无人机镜头拍摄以及会下车的警察，提升了游戏的互动性和真实感。该项目仍在持续开发中，目标是打造一个具备完整目标和反应机制的演示系统，可用于品牌推广、产品发布或病毒式可玩广告。
summary_en: This is a browser-based city simulation game developed by an 18-year-old using the Claude workflow. Initially featuring cars, roads, and basic movement, it has evolved to include missions, traffic lights, wider streets, named shops, motel signs, house labels, and a cleaner city layout. Details such as NPC conversations, improved textures, enhanced lighting, smoother drone shots, and police exiting vehicles have been added to increase interactivity and realism. The project is ongoing, aiming to create a demo with full objectives and responsive elements suitable for brand demos, product launches, or viral playable ads.
workflow_steps_en: Develop basic city layout with cars, roads, and movement
Add missions, traffic lights, wider streets
Implement named shops, motel signs, and house labels
Improve city layout for cleanliness
Enhance small details: NPC conversations, textures, lighting, drone shots
Add police that exit vehicles
Continuously expand features to enhance demo’s sellability
workflow_steps: 初期构建汽车、道路及基本移动功能

实现命名商店、汽车旅馆标志及住宅标签
优化城市布局更整洁
提升小细节：NPC对话、纹理、光照、无人机镜头
新增会下车的警察
持续扩展功能提升演示价值
evidence_quotes: the first build was just cars, roads and basic movement. now it has missions, traffic lights, wider streets, named shops, motel signs, house labels and a cleaner city layout

title: 基于Claude Opus 5.5的全3D浏览器游戏
summary: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的全3D游戏，利用Claude Opus 5.5、Tripo和Blender制作。项目将书本内容拆分成章节，每个星球作为一个场景，利用Opus规划故事和交互，通过Tripo生成角色和大型道具，Blender中搭建星球场景，Unity中实现角色移动和交互，多语言支持，最终为浏览器构建分章节下载的版本。
summary_en: This is a full 3D game running in a browser, created using Claude Opus 5.5, Tripo, and Blender. The book is divided into chapters, with each planet as a scene. Opus plans story and interactions; Tripo generates characters and large props; Opus builds planets in Blender; Unity handles character movement and interactions; supports multiple languages; and the game is built for browser with each chapter downloadable separately.
workflow_steps_en: Break the book into chapters and assign each planet as a separate scene list
Use Claude Opus 5.5 to plan the game structure including chapters, interactions, story text, and loading
Generate characters and large props like the prince, king, fox, plane, and train using Tripo
Build each planet scene in Blender through MCP by placing models, adding clouds, lighting, and mood via Opus
Import all scenes into Unity and have Opus code walking, interactions, and story moments
Add support for three languages (English, Chinese, Japanese) with one text file per language
Build the game for the browser using WebGPU with each chapter loaded as a separate download
Create the trailer using Opus and Blender with camera flights through the scenes
workflow_steps: 把书拆分成章节并将每个星球作为场景列表
使用Claude Opus 5.5规划游戏结构：章节、交互、故事文本和加载
用Tripo生成角色和大型道具：王子、国王、狐狸、飞机、火车
通过Opus和MCP在Blender中构建每个星球场景：摆放模型，添加云朵、光照和氛围
将所有场景导入Unity，Opus编写角色行走、交互和故事事件
添加三个语言支持（英语、中文、日语），每种语言一个文本文件
用WebGPU为浏览器构建游戏，实现分章节加载下载
使用Opus和Blender制作预告片，通过摄像机飞行浏览完成场景
skills_or_prompts_used: 场景搭建与光照氛围设定
evidence_quotes: full 3D game that runs in a browser, using Claude Opus 5.5 + Tripo + Blender...
step 1: break the book into chapters and turn each planet into a scene list
step 2: have opus 5.5 plan the game: chapters, interactions, story text, loading
step 3: generate the characters and big props in tripo: the prince, the king, the fox, the plane, the train
step 4: have opus build each planet in blender through mcp: place the models, add clouds, light and mood
step 5: bring every scene into unity, then have opus code walking, interactions and story moments
step 6: add 3 languages (english, chinese, japanese) with one text file per language
step 7: build for the browser with webgpu and load each chapter as its own download
step 8: make the trailer with opus + blender: camera flights through the finished scenes
one huge download won’t load in a browser, but one planet at a time will

title: BLINDSIDE
summary: 《茫室》是一款由 Blasin 团队于 2026 年机核 BOOOM Jam 21 天游戏开发挑战中打造的俯视角射击游戏。游戏全部代码由 AI（Cursor + Codex）生成，音效与音乐由 ElevenLabs AI 生成，美术及关卡设计由团队人力完成。游戏特色在于敌人在光照下无敌，玩家需要预判敌人移动并在黑暗中射击。游戏时长约 40 分钟，支持键鼠及手柄操作。
summary_en: BLINDSIDE is a top-down shooter developed by the Blasin team in the 21-day GCORE BOOOM Jam 2026. All code was AI-generated using Cursor and Codex, with sound effects and music created by ElevenLabs AI, while art and level design were human-made by the team. The game features enemies invulnerable in light, requiring players to predict enemy movements and shoot in the dark. Playtime is about 40 minutes, supporting keyboard & mouse and gamepad.
workflow_steps_en: Use AI agents Cursor and Codex to generate all game code with zero hand-written lines.
Utilize Cursor Debug Mode for iterative debugging: form hypotheses, insert debug logs, reproduce bugs, analyze logs, then fix.
Generate all audio and music using ElevenLabs AI, integrating via Codex script calls.
Manage assets and game configuration via natural language naming and AI-assisted directory management.
Perform data analysis and profiling using AI to optimize game parameters.
Use Unity MCP for iterative compile and fix cycles with play mode smoke tests.
Employ AI for Git conflict resolution and bisect-based bug tracking.
Design art and levels humanly, with AI supporting tasks like JSON manipulation for level data.
workflow_steps: 使用 Cursor 和 Codex 完成所有代码生成，零手写代码。
利用 Cursor Debug Mode 进行调试：形成假设，植入调试日志，复现 bug，分析日志，修复问题。
音效与音乐使用 ElevenLabs AI 生成，通过 Codex 调用集成。
通过自然语言命名和 AI 辅助管理资源和游戏配置。
用 AI 进行数据分析和性能优化。
使用 Unity MCP 反复编译、修复和运行测试。
AI 自动处理 Git 冲突并进行二分查找定位 bug。
人工完成美术和关卡设计，AI 协助 JSON 关卡数据操作。

title: TITAN 6×6 Futuristic Armored Monster Truck
summary: 使用Gemini 4 Neon模型自动生成的未来装甲六轮怪物卡车，基于单张参考图片，具备真实驾驶物理和机械系统。该世界通过程序生成234K三角面、92个网格、58个机械枢轴和25种PBR纹理，含有6轮刚体物理、液气悬挂、牵引绞盘、多机械剖面层及动态阴影和引擎音效。无手工建模或外部3D资源，体现了高度复杂的自动化工程设计。
summary_en: A futuristic armored 6-wheel monster truck automatically generated by Gemini 4 Neon from a single reference image, featuring realistic driving physics and mechanical systems. The world procedurally generates 234K triangles, 92 meshes, 58 mechanical pivots, and 25 PBR textures, includes 6-wheel rigid-body physics, hydropneumatic suspension, recovery winch, multiple mechanical cutaway layers, dynamic shaders, and procedural engine audio. No manual modeling or external 3D assets used, showcasing advanced automated engineering design.
workflow_steps_en: Input a single reference image of the TITAN 6×6 monster truck into Gemini 4 Neon.
Use over 100 swarms to generate the 3D model and engineering systems.
Procedurally generate high-polygon 3D meshes with textures and mechanical pivots.
Implement physics and mechanical systems such as 6-wheel raycast rigid-body physics, hydropneumatic suspension, and winch simulation.
Generate interactive mechanical cutaway layers, CAD and blueprint views.
Add custom shaders with dynamic lighting, tire dust, and procedural engine sounds.
Perform automated geometry validation for duplicates, overlaps, and collisions.
workflow_steps: 输入单张TITAN 6×6怪物卡车参考图到Gemini 4 Neon。
使用100+个群集推动三维模型和工程系统生成。

实现6轮刚体物理、液气悬挂和牵引绞盘仿真。
生成交互机械剖面层、CAD与蓝图视图。
添加动态光照、轮胎尘埃和程序化引擎音效着色器。
自动检测并修正几何重叠、重复面和碰撞。

title: 12-Year-Old's Player-Hosted 3D Multiplayer World Created with Claude
summary: 一名12岁中国孩子使用Claude生成模型描述需求，制作了一个包含物理引擎的完整3D多人世界。他自行设计地图，朋友们可以通过各自家中加入，一起探索这个生动的世界。无游戏引擎教程，无编码经验，无团队，仅凭描述实现。第一月200名用户，每月4.99美元订阅费用，月收入约1000美元。
summary_en: A 12-year-old Chinese child used the Claude generative model to describe his needs and created a full 3D multiplayer world with physics. He designed the map himself. Friends join from their own homes to explore the lively world together. No game engine tutorials, no coding experience, no team—just a description-based creation. In the first month, 200 users subscribed at $4.99/month, generating about $1,000 monthly revenue.

Claude generated the complete 3D world with physics and multiplayer features
Designed the map personally
Launched the world online so friends can join remotely
Charged $4.99/month subscription to users

summary_en: Carbon made a pelican biking demo showcasing long-horizon coding and Google's /swarm feature. Builder and critic subagents ran iterative loops across Blender and Three.js, checking their own renders to build a playable 3D game of a pelican biking around the Mountain View campus.
workflow_steps_en: Use Google /swarm feature to create builder and critic subagents.
Subagents run iterative development loops involving Blender and Three.js.
Subagents self-assess their rendered outputs.
Build a playable 3D pelican biking game set in Mountain View campus.
workflow_steps: 使用 Google /swarm 功能创建构建者和评价者子代理。

构建一个可玩的 3D 鹈鹕骑自行车游戏，场景为 Mountain View 校区。
evidence_quotes: Carbon made a pelican demo so you don't have to 😅
fun test of long-horizon coding and the new /swarm feature in Google @Antigravity.

title: Maxwell’s demon
summary: 这是一个模拟麦克斯韦妖的交互式演示，旨在帮助用户理解热力学中的熵和混合熵概念。它通过一个三维盒子中不同颜色的粒子（红色和白色）在左右两个隔间中的分布和排序，展示信息熵和能量消耗的关系。用户可以拖动旋转盒子，控制门的开闭，调节粒子数量和运动速度，体验麦克斯韦妖如何通过开关门将不同颜色的粒子分隔，从而影响混合熵。
summary_en: This is an interactive demo simulating Maxwell's demon to help users understand concepts of thermodynamic entropy and mixing entropy. It features colored particles (red and white) distributed and sorted in left and right compartments within a 3D box. Users can rotate the box, control door opening, adjust particle count and speed, and observe how the demon sorts particles to affect mixing entropy and related energy requirements.
workflow_steps_en: Display a 3D box containing red and white particles distributed between left and right chambers.
Allow user to drag to rotate the box and observe particles.
Provide controls to open/close doors and hold open state, simulating the demon's gate operations.
Implement a 'demon' agent that sorts red particles to the left and white to the right by opening the door accordingly.
Provide live readouts including polarity, mixing entropy in bits per particle, and side information content.
Allow speed adjustments (1×, 4×, 16×) for particle movement simulation.
Support particle count adjustments which restart the simulation box.
workflow_steps: 显示一个包含红色和白色粒子的三维盒子，这些粒子分布在左右两个隔间。
允许用户拖动以旋转盒子并观察粒子。
提供控制门开关和保持开门状态的操作，用于模拟妖的门操作。
实现一个“妖”，通过打开门将红色粒子移向左侧，白色粒子移向右侧。
提供极性、混合熵（每粒子比特）和侧面信息内容的实时读数。
允许调整运动速度（1×，4×，16×）进行粒子运动模拟。
支持调整粒子数量，调整后重启模拟盒子。
evidence_quotes: Walking around with horns and an iPad running a vibe-coded demo to teach people thermodynamics at the party.
The glass door and gaze illustrate an ideal, instantly responding demon. The spheres move and collide in three dimensions.
Color mixing · live
Mixing entropy H(C \| S) measures how uncertain its color remains after you know its side.
Polarity measures alignment with red on the left and white on the right: −100% is reversed, 0% is neutral, and +100% is the target arrangement.

title: Opus 5.5による竹林の島と海の景色制作
summary: 海外クリエイターがOpus 5.5とThree.jsでブラウザ上に動作する竹林の島と海の景色を制作。画像生成AIは使わず、物理計算を基にした光や海の描画仕組みをコードで組み、見た目を実際のゲームや映画の場面から数値で合わせる手法を用いる。
summary_en: A foreign creator used Opus 5.5 and Three.js to create a bamboo forest island and sea scenery that runs in the browser. Instead of using image-generation AI, the rendering mechanism is built with code based on physical calculations of light and sea, and the appearance is matched numerically to reference scenes from actual games and movies.
workflow_steps_en: Build rendering mechanism in Opus 5.5 based on research and Three.js techniques that calculates sea waves, sky color, light scattering, volumetric clouds, shadows, fog, brightness and local light/dark areas without using image-generation AI.
Select a dozen reference images from games and movies by weather, time of day, and composition; this step is done manually.
Measure brightness, color density, and tone at 7-8 points (e.g. sunlit grass, shaded grass, sky near sun, distant sea) in each reference image and created scene for comparison.
Compute settings that minimize differences across more than 100 measured points; iterate the process of rendering, measuring, and adjusting until numerical values match.
workflow_steps: 用Unreal公開技術を基にThree.js描画の仕組みをOpus 5.5に組み込み、波・光・雲・陰影・霧・明暗を計算で描画し画像生成AIは使わない。
実際のゲーム・映画から天気・時間帯・構図を元に十数枚のお手本画像を手で選ぶ。
お手本画像の7~8ヶ所（日なたの草、日陰の草、空、海など）の明るさと色を作成景色と測定し比較。
100以上の場所で差が最小になる設定を計算で探し描画→測定→修正を繰り返し数値が合うまで調整。
evidence_quotes: ・論文や講演、Unrealが公開している技術をもとに、Three.jsの描画の仕組みをOpus 5.5に組ませる
・海は波を計算して作り、空の色・光の回り込み・立体的な雲も入れる
・物の陰・霧・明るさの自動調整・場所ごとの明暗の調整を足す
・見た目は全部この計算から出す。画像生成AIは使わない

title: ThreeJS Camera Interactive Tool
summary: 这是一个使用ThreeJS构建的交互式相机教学工具。通过调整视野角度、近裁剪面和远裁剪面，用户能观察透视锥体的变化及渲染效果，从而理解ThreeJS中相机的工作原理。界面包括一个可旋转观察的金字塔模型，和用于显示相机实际渲染内容的窗口。
summary_en: This is an interactive camera teaching tool built with ThreeJS. By adjusting the field of view, near plane, and far plane, users can observe changes in the perspective frustum and rendering, helping them understand how cameras work in ThreeJS. The interface includes a rotatable pyramid model and a window showing the actual camera output.
workflow_steps_en: User interacts with the 3D scene by orbiting the camera with the mouse.
User adjusts the Field of View (FOV) parameter to see how it affects the pyramid width and render output.
User adjusts the Near Plane to observe how objects closer than this distance are clipped.
User adjusts the Far Plane to observe how objects beyond this depth are clipped.
The camera output window dynamically shows what the camera renders based on these parameters.
workflow_steps: 用户用鼠标环绕观察3D场景。
用户调整视野角度(FOV)，观察金字塔宽度和渲染输出变化。
用户调整近裁剪面，观察小于该距离的物体被裁剪。
用户调整远裁剪面，观察超出该深度的物体被裁剪。
相机输出窗口动态显示当前相机渲染内容。

summary: 利用Fable 5.2組織流程，從普通的花草照片自動生成在Unity中可直接使用的3D草花模型。草花共18種，每根草由18個三角形組成，設有風動效果；鬱金香設有三種多細節層次模型。生成同時產出法線貼圖、透光貼圖、風動遮罩及合併的紋理貼圖。整個過程涵蓋拍照、轉換風格到3D並用刷子植入地面，成為一連串AI驅動的工作流。使用工具包含Fable 5.2 Hermes Agent、Nano Banana Pro、Meshy AI、Blender及Unity 6，運行約8小時。

Tools include Fable 5.2 Hermes Agent, Nano Banana Pro, Meshy AI, Blender, and Unity 6, running about 8 hours.

title: 3D設計ツールシリーズ（3D打ち合せツールと3D構想設計ツール）
summary: 作者はAIを用いて2つの3D設計支援ツールを開発した。1つ目はSTEPデータからブラウザで閲覧可能なHTML形式に変換し、顧客向けと社内向けに必要情報を区別して提示できる「3D打ち合せツール」。顧客はブラウザで3Dモデルを操作・計測可能で、社内は組立・材料発注を容易にするCSVデータを生成する。2つ目は構想設計の手順をClaudeでスキル化し、Google Drive上のヒアリングシートなどの資料をもとに構想図のSTEPデータを自動生成する「3D構想設計ツール」。まだ開発途上で現場の実務に適合させる作業を継続中。目標は3DCAD操作なしに打ち合わせから見積提出まで完結可能な業務フローの実現。
summary_en: The author developed two AI-driven 3D design support tools. The first is a "3D Meeting Tool" that converts STEP data into browser-viewable HTML, separating necessary information for clients and internal use. Clients can interact with 3D models and measure dimensions in-browser, while internal staff receive CSV data for assembly and materials ordering. The second is a "3D Conceptual Design Tool" that uses Claude to automate conceptual design steps by reading hearing sheets and other documents from Google Drive to output STEP data. The second tool is still being refined through practical use. The aim is to complete the workflow from meetings to quotation submissions without opening 3DCAD software.
workflow_steps_en: Convert 3D-CAD assemblies to STEP format.
Convert STEP data to HTML for browser viewing with selectable information layers (client/internal).
Enable client-side 3D interaction: rotation, measurement, transparency.
Generate CSV data for internal assembly and materials verification.
Develop Claude skill encapsulating conceptual design steps.
Integrate Google Drive plugin to read project-specific hearing sheets and materials.
Automatically output conceptual STEP diagrams from collected data.
Iteratively improve tools based on practical usage and user feedback.
workflow_steps: 3D-CADで作成したアセンブリをSTEPに変換する。
STEPデータをブラウザで開けるHTMLに変換し、顧客向けと社内向けの必要情報を選別して同時出力する。
顧客はブラウザで3Dを回転、寸法測定、部品透明化で中を確認可能にする。
社内向けには組立・材料発注の確認用にCSVで発注本数や部品数を出力する。
構想設計の進め方をClaudeにスキル化する。
Google Driveプラグインで案件ごとのヒアリングシートを読み込み可能にする。
ヒアリングシート・文章・ポンチ絵・音声文字起こしから構想図をSTEPデータで出力する。
現場で使いながら機能改良を繰り返し、業務フローに合う道具とする。
evidence_quotes: 構想設計の進め方を手順としてまとめ、Claudeにスキル化しました。Googledriveをプラグインして閲覧できるようにしておき、案件ごとのヒアリングシートをドライブに置いておけば、そのまま読み込んで構想図をSTEPデータで出します。

title: AI制作の海賊船3Dシーン比較：Blender vs Three.js
summary: 同じ海賊船の3DシーンをAIのOpus 5.5に作らせ、BlenderとThree.js双方で比較。Blenderは高品質だが制作に2時間かかりレンダリングも必要。Three.jsは28分で生成し、そのままブラウザで毎秒60コマで動作。Blender版は修正が多かった一方、Three.js版の海の波や泡は1回目で成功。細かさならBlender、速さと即時動作はThree.jsが優れる。
summary_en: The same pirate ship 3D scene was generated using AI Opus 5.5 via both Blender and Three.js for comparison. Blender produces higher quality but takes 2 hours plus rendering. Three.js generates in 28 minutes and runs in browser at 60 FPS. Blender required more fixes, while Three.js succeeded on ocean waves and foam on first try. Blender excels in detail; Three.js excels in speed and instant interactivity.
workflow_steps_en: Use AI model Opus 5.5 to generate 3D pirate ship scene.
Generate scene using Blender, requiring 2 hours plus rendering.
Generate scene using Three.js in 28 minutes, running directly in browser at 60 FPS.
Compare image quality, generation time, interactivity, and needed fixes between Blender and Three.js versions.

title: Opus 5.5 Studio Game Development
summary: Opus 5.5 使用 Claude Code 项目管理整合一个游戏工作室的所有角色，包括设计、程序、美术、音效、QA 和制作人。设计阶段通过提问确定要点并产出设计文档；程序员先实现基础核心玩法，快速可玩；美术和音效用三.js 代码和 WebAudio 代码实现；QA 利用自动化脚本进行手机尺寸的自动化测试和评分，修复主要问题；制作人在关键节点参与管理项目，最终将作品发布到 GitHub Pages。整个流程以代码为核心，且可玩性和测试自动化为重点。
summary_en: Opus 5.5 uses a Claude Code project to integrate all game studio roles—design, programming, art, sound, QA, and production—into one repo. Design asks 5 questions then writes design docs; programming ships an ugly core loop playable in 30 seconds; art and sound create assets using three.js and WebAudio code; QA runs automated phone-sized playtests scoring screenshots and fixes the worst issues; the producer manages key milestones and final shipping to GitHub Pages. The workflow centers on code-driven development, automated testing, and iterative improvements to deliver a playable browser game.
workflow_steps_en: Design asks up to 5 questions, then writes docs/design.md and docs/style.md, awaiting approval
Programmer ships an ugly core gameplay loop first, playable in 30 seconds
Artist builds models using three.js code; sound designer codes every effect using WebAudio
QA runs playtest.mjs with Playwright at phone size, scoring screenshots 1-10 and fixing the 3 worst problems until all scores are 8 or above
Producer commits after each working step and sets stopping points for overnight runs; shipping deploys to GitHub Pages
workflow_steps: 设计阶段提问5个问题后写设计文档，等待确认
程序员先做出30秒内可玩的核心玩法原型
美术用three.js代码造模型，音效用WebAudio写效果
QA用Playwright写自动化手机尺寸试玩脚本并评分修复，确保所有评分超过8分
制作人每个工作环节后提交，设定隔夜运行停止点，发布到GitHub Pages
skills_or_prompts_used: 工作室管理分工与流程设计
evidence_quotes: Opus 5.5 can run a whole game studio from one Claude Code project.

title: 激軽疑似３Dボクセルアートのデモ
summary: 話題の激軽疑似3Dボクセルアートは、360度滑らかに回転し、2Dのピクセルアートの質感を保ちつつ立体的に見せるスプライト技術による疑似3D表現。小さな横長PNG1枚で全角度対応し、実装は2D描画に数十行追加するだけと非常に簡単。Pythonで4面図からスライスを自動生成可能で、静止物の描画負荷も低い。Gemini 4 NeonやNanoBanana、GPT Image 2.6による生成が可能で、ゲームや幅広い用途に適用できる。
summary_en: This trending ultra-light pseudo-3D voxel art demo uses sprite techniques to show 2D pixel art as fully 3D with smooth 360-degree rotation without multiple sprite directions. A single small wide PNG handles all angles, and implementation requires adding only a few dozen lines to 2D rendering. Python can auto-generate slices from four-view images. Static objects have minimal performance cost. Generation can be done using Gemini 4 Neon, NanoBanana, or GPT Image 2.6. Suitable for games and various applications.
workflow_steps_en: Prepare 4-view images (top, side, front, back) as source.
Use Python script to automatically slice and generate pseudo-3D sprites from these images.
Create a small wide PNG that covers all angles for smooth 360-degree rotation.
Implement sprite rendering by adding several dozen lines to 2D drawing code, without 3D engine or special shaders.
Adjust camera squash values numerically to achieve different viewing angles from top-down to diagonal.
Use spacing parameters to create vertical stretching or explosion effects.
Optionally bake static objects like trees or buildings into single images at runtime for low rendering cost.
workflow_steps: 用4面図（上・横・前・後）の画像を用意する。
Pythonスクリプトでこれらの画像からスライスを自動生成する。
全角度を含む横長の小さなPNGを作成し、滑らかに360度回転表示可能にする。
2D描画に数十行のコードを追加し、3Dエンジンや専用シェーダなしでスプライト描画を実装する。
視点のsquash値を変え、真上〜斜め見下ろしのカメラ角に対応させる。
spacingパラメータで縦伸縮やバラバラ爆発などの演出を行う。
静止物は起動時に1枚絵に焼き付けて描画負荷を軽減する。
evidence_quotes: Gemini 4 Neonのおかげでほんまに簡単に実装できるからガチでいいんだよな、これ。
5分で出来たからね、私のデモ。
これは、フラットな画像を重ねて3Dっぽく見せてるスプライト技術
360度ぬるぬる回る：8方向・16方向のスプライト描き分けが不要
2Dなのに立体的：高さ方向に重なるので、側面や屋根が自然に見える
ドット絵がくっきり：3D化と違い、ピクセルアートの質感が崩れない
カメラ角を数値で調整：squash を変えるだけで真上〜斜め見下ろしに対応
演出も簡単：spacing を変えるだけで、縦に伸び縮み・バラバラに爆発などが作れる
素材が超軽量：小さい横長PNG 1枚だけで全角度をまかなえる
実装がかんたん：3Dエンジンや専用シェーダ不要。2D描画に数十行足すだけ
4面図から自動生成：上・横・前・後の絵があれば、Pythonでスライスを自動作成できる
静止物はさらに軽い：木や建物は起動時に1枚絵へ焼き付ければ、描画負荷が増えない

Import scenes into Unity and code character movement, interactions, and story moments with Opus.
Add support for three languages (English, Chinese, Japanese) via separate text files.
Build the game for the browser using WebGPU and load each chapter as its own downloadable scene.
Create the trailer with Opus and Blender through animated camera flights in scenes.

将所有场景导入Unity，使用Opus编写角色移动、交互和故事片段代码。

title: Watercolour
summary: Watercolour是一个three.js制作的互动游戏世界，初始画面为铅笔素描，玩家走过的地方会随着脚步逐渐展开水彩画效果。颜料从脚下扩散，附着在树木、花草和水流上，呈现真实水彩渲染特性如湿润边缘和颜色渐变。场景包含树林、小溪和有盛开树木的草地，玩家控制一位穿红色兜帽的小女孩进行探索，游戏无声音。
summary_en: Watercolour is an interactive three.js game world that starts as a pencil drawing and watercolor painting spreads from the player's footsteps. The paint flows unevenly, climbing trees, running down streams, and coloring areas the player visits. The scene features a wood, a stream with stepping stones, and a blossom tree meadow, controlled by a red-hooded girl. There is no sound.
workflow_steps_en: Initialize the scene as a pencil drawing on paper.
Track the arrival time of paint at every ground point using createWash().
Assign a root point and paint flow speed to each vertex for realistic fill, e.g., trees fill from roots to leaves.
Render paint as pigment on paper with characteristics like pooling and wet edges.
Generate foliage as multiple brush touches with varying pigment strength.
Apply wet-into-wet blending in selected paper areas for realistic watercolor effect.
Construct hills as cascading washes with mist effects.
Animate life (grass sway, running stream, falling petals, butterflies) only after corresponding paint is applied.
workflow_steps: 场景最初为纸上的铅笔素描。
通过createWash()记录颜料抵达地面每点的时间。
每个顶点对应一个根部和颜料扩散速度，如树木从根向叶子填充颜色。
颜料表现为纸上颜料的薄层，有湿润边缘和色彩深浅变化。
树叶、草叶和花瓣通过多次刷触生成，色素浓淡各异。
在纸上指定湿润区域实现湿中湿的水彩混染效果。
丘陵通过层层水洗效果表现，薄雾渐隐。
动画效果如草摆动、小溪流动、花瓣落下和蝴蝶飞舞仅在被涂色后触发。
evidence_quotes: A three.js world that begins as a pencil drawing on paper and is painted in watercolour as you walk through it.

It allows importing any image and extracting sprites, painting levels, placing objects, adding NPCs, writing dialogues, scripting cutscenes, bosses, keys, doors, powerups, sound/music, and saving or exporting the game as playable HTML. Integrated Claude AI enables live interactive generation of rooms, bosses, lore, and map layouts during building. The tool supports hybrid AI-human workflows for fast prototyping and custom 2D game creation.

Playtest instantly in the browser using the Play command.
Export the entire project as a playable HTML game or save the builder state as an .html file.

title: 分液ロートによる液液抽出3Dシミュレーション
summary: 这是一个液液抽出的三维模拟交互世界，可以在浏览器和手机端运行。用户可操作分液漏斗进行摇晃使两相乳化，再静置使其分层，同时观察溶质（色素）自水相向有机相迁移。界面实时显示各层体积、溶质质量和回收率。具备开阀放出下层液体的功能，并有过量放出警告。支持两次提取，溶质包含分配系数K=8的色素和K=40的碘类物质。
summary_en: This is a 3D simulation interactive world of liquid-liquid extraction operable via browser and mobile. Users manipulate the separatory funnel by shaking to emulsify phases, then allow settling to separate layers, observing solute transfer from aqueous to organic phase. The interface displays real-time volumes, solute mass, and recovery rates per layer. It includes a stopcock to drain the lower layer with over-drain warning and supports a second extraction. Solutes modeled are an orange dye with partition coefficient K=8 and an iodine-like substance with K=40.
workflow_steps_en: User opens the simulation in browser or smartphone.
User shakes the separatory funnel to emulsify the two liquid layers.
User lets the mixture settle to separate into two layers.
The solute transfers from the aqueous lower layer to the organic upper layer according to partition coefficients.
User operates the stopcock to drain the lower aqueous layer, with warning if over-drain occurs causing organic contamination.
User may add fresh solvent and perform a second extraction.
workflow_steps: ユーザーはブラウザやスマホで3Dシミュレーションを開く。
分液ロートを振って二相を乳化させる。
静置して二層に分離させる。
溶質が分配係数に従い下層の水層から上の有機層へ移動する。
ユーザーはコックを操作して下層を抜き取る。過剰に抜くと有機層混入警告が出る。
新しい溶媒を足して二回目の抽出を行うことも可能。
evidence_quotes: Claudeに作ってもらった液液抽出の3Dシミュレーションです。分液ロートを振ると乳化して、静置すると2層に戻り、色（溶質）が下の水層から上の有機層へ移ります。各層の量と溶質のmg、回収率がその場で数値表示されます。
コックを開けて下層を抜く操作つきで、抜きすぎると有機層まで混入して警告が出ます。新しい溶媒を足して2回目の抽出もできます。
溶質は分配係数K=8の色素と、K=40のヨウ素風の2種類。

title: Lumenfall vs Aetherfall: AI-Generated Voxel Worlds
summary: 比较了Claude Opus 5.5（云端）与DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（四台DGX Sparks硬件）基于相同体素世界提示词生成的两个交互世界。Claude Opus 5.5耗时33.2分钟，成本约7.82美元，生成了Lumenfall世界；DeepSeek在自有硬件上耗时49.7分钟，生成Aetherfall世界。两者浏览器体验得分均为9.0/10，质量相近。Opus使用云端环境，支持较长上下文和网络访问；DeepSeek在本地硬件环境限制条件下运行。可在浏览器中试玩Spark生成的Aetherfall世界。
summary_en: Comparison between Claude Opus 5.5 (cloud) and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (four DGX Sparks local hardware) generating voxel worlds from the same prompt. Claude Opus 5.5 took 33.2 minutes at cost around $7.82, producing the Lumenfall world; DeepSeek took 49.7 minutes on own hardware, producing Aetherfall world. Both scored 9.0/10 on browser check, showing similar quality. Opus ran in cloud with large context and internet, DeepSeek ran locally with hardware limits. Aetherfall world is playable in browser.
workflow_steps_en: Prepare voxel-world prompt.
Run Claude Opus 5.5 model on cloud with large context (about 71,000 tokens) and internet access.
Run DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model on four DGX Spark boxes using TensorFold recipe with neighbor-ring mode on local hardware.
Measure generation time and token count for each model.
Evaluate generated worlds by browser check score and quality comparison.
Publish results and offer browser play demo for the DeepSeek Aetherfall world.
workflow_steps: 准备体素世界的提示词。
在云端使用Claude Opus 5.5模型，带约71,000标记的上下文和网络访问，生成Lumenfall世界。
在4台DGX Spark本地硬件上利用TensorFold邻近环模式运行DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash模型，生成Aetherfall世界。
测量各模型耗时和生成标记数。
通过浏览器检测得分和质量对比评价生成世界。
发布结果并提供DeepSeek生成Aetherfall世界的浏览器游玩演示。
evidence_quotes: Claude Opus 5.5 in the cloud against DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on four DGX Sparks: same voxel-world prompt, one try each.

title: Arkenfall
summary: Arkenfall是一个大型3D浏览器游戏世界，完全由运行时生成的程序性纺织和编织元素构成，没有使用任何网格、纹理或声音资源。游戏中包含独特的纺织主题设定，如纱线、结点、织机巨兽和解开者等，环境由三维地形、水体和光照组成。玩家在游戏中操作角色在‘褪色谷’（The Frayed Vale）探险，使用特殊武器“纺锤枪”（The Spindle Glaive）战斗，体验织造与解开的核心机制。技术栈包括Three.js、TypeScript和Vite。
summary_en: Arkenfall is a large 3D browser game world entirely generated at runtime with procedural woven and textile elements, involving no loaded meshes, textures, or sounds. The setting features textile-themed entities like threads, knotguards, loomhulks, and unravelled creatures, with environment comprising terrain, water, sky, and lighting. Players explore the Frayed Vale, wielding the Spindle Glaive weapon, engaging in combat and weaving/unraveling mechanics. Tech stack includes Three.js, TypeScript, and Vite.
workflow_steps_en: Generate the entire game world procedurally at runtime without loading external assets.
Construct the environment using woven stone, cloth, and clay motifs alongside natural elements like spindlepines and reeds.
Implement gameplay mechanics centering on weaving, unravelling, and combat with entities such as Knotguards and Loomhulks.
Design UI and settings including controls, sound, display options, and an inventory system.
Use Three.js, TypeScript, and Vite to build the interactive 3D browser game.
workflow_steps: 运行时程序生成整个游戏世界，无加载外部资源。
使用编织的石头、布料及粘土元素构建环境，辅以自然元素如旋叶松和芦苇。
实现围绕纺织、解开及与结点卫士和织机巨兽等敌人的战斗机制。
设计包括操作控制、声音、显示选项和物品栏在内的用户界面与设置。
使用Three.js、TypeScript和Vite开发3D交互浏览器游戏。
evidence_quotes: No meshes, textures or sounds were loaded — the whole Vale is woven at runtime.
Three.js · TypeScript · Vite
